run_pose_visualization: run the pose estimation demo on images or videos with a checkpoint file and optional detector
run_batch_inference: run batch top-down pose inference on a list of images with optional flip augmentation
run_preprocess_pose: run preprocessing on images and bounding boxes to extract cropped, normalized pose input images
run_img_save_and_vis: run visualization and save pose keypoints and skeleton on images with heatmap decoding
run_load_model: run loading of a pose estimation model from a checkpoint file supporting torchscript or exported formats
